verdict.rationale: Muse is documented as a built-in personal AI agent that users delegate goals/tasks to, tracks and follows up on them (Goals tab, monitoring, scheduling), can build its own tools/connectors when needed, and can even complete actions like purchases with approval — this is core, richly documented functionality (muse-docs-1, muse-docs-5, muse-docs-7, muse-docs-16, muse-docs-20, muse-docs-24, muse-docs-27). However, an independent hands-on report found the agent's control plane started timing out under stress testing, indicating reliability limits when delegation is pushed hard. missing for 10: broader independent corroboration of consistent task delegation success, and resolution of the reported control-plane reliability issue under load.
